description: Search luxury resale listings, browse a category or brand, or fetch specific product URLs. Filter by condition, seller country and price, then sort the results.

brandSlug.description: Brand slug or brand page URL, e.g. `gucci`, `louis-vuitton`, `hermes`, or `https://www.vestiairecollective.com/chanel/`. Used by the `byBrand` mode.
brandSlug.title: Brand (browse a brand)

categorySlug.description: Vestiaire category to browse. Used by the `byCategory` mode.
categorySlug.title: Category (browse a category)

condition.description: Only return items in this condition grade.
condition.title: Condition

includeDetails.description: Open each listing's product page for extra fields: material, subcategory, measurements, seller username and seller statistics. Adds one request per item and makes the run slower.
includeDetails.title: Fetch product details

market.description: Vestiaire storefront used for prices and availability. Each market returns prices in its own currency.
market.title: Market

maxItems.description: Maximum number of listings to return (1–1000).
maxItems.title: Max items

maxPrice.description: Maximum listing price in the selected market's currency.
maxPrice.title: Maximum price

minPrice.description: Minimum listing price in the selected market's currency.
minPrice.title: Minimum price

productUrls.description: Specific Vestiaire product page URLs to scrape. Used by the `byUrl` mode.
productUrls.title: Product URLs

searchQuery.description: Keyword, model or brand to search for, e.g. `gucci bag`, `chanel classic flap`, `hermes kelly 28`.
searchQuery.title: Search query

sellerCountries.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes for where the seller/item is located, e.g. `FR`, `IT`, `US`. Leave empty for all countries.
sellerCountries.title: Seller countries

soldOnly.description: Return only items Vestiaire has marked as sold. Useful for sold-price comparables.
soldOnly.title: Sold items only

title: Vestiaire Collective Pre-Owned Luxury Price Tracker Input
